description: This file defines a class MD5 used for computing MD5 hashes within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for reading XLS files.

classes.name: MD5
classes.description: Class for computing MD5 hash streams, used internally for XLS file reading.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MD5 class, setting default hash values.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the hash context to initial MD5 values.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the current hash state as a string.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds data to the hash context for incremental MD5 calculation.
